description: Hostile documents that fail structurally before or during verification.

cases.name: strict-decode-extra-top-level-field
cases.description: A receipt document with an unknown top-level field.

cases.name: wrong-spec-version
cases.description: A receipt declaring another epoch's spec version (0.2); a conforming v0.3 validator rejects it with an unsupported-version report.

cases.name: not-json
cases.description: Arbitrary bytes that do not parse as JSON.

cases.name: truncated-json
cases.description: The receipt document cut in half.

cases.name: duplicate-top-level-field
cases.description: A receipt document that declares `spec_version` twice; strict decoding rejects the duplicate key.

cases.name: malformed-signature-field-types
cases.description: A record whose signature carries a numeric key_id and a non-byte sig; strict decoding rejects the mistyped fields.

cases.name: exceeds-max-bytes
cases.description: A valid receipt rejected because it exceeds a tiny byte budget.

cases.name: exceeds-max-records
cases.description: A valid multi-record receipt rejected under a one-record budget.

cases.name: exceeds-max-refs-comparative-selection
cases.description: A comparative Selection accepted by the verifier at max_considered, but its ref count exceeds a tight receipt ref budget.
